item.title: Whiskers 0.8.44
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.44

### Retroactive AI Enhancement

  • Rewrite highlighted text while recording by pressing the retroactive shortcut, then speaking the change you want
  • Added a dedicated retroactive shortcut so you can trigger selection edits without interrupting your normal dictation flow

    • ### Improvements

  • Improved hotkey guidance in Settings so it’s clearer how retroactive editing works and when it’s available
  • Improved the recording HUD so it’s easier to tell when Whiskers is in edit-selection mode

    • ### Bug Fixes

  • Prevented retroactive edits from changing text when no clear rewrite was produced
  • Kept recordings in normal dictation mode when AI enhancement or selected text is not available
